description: This file defines an interface (IIterator) and several template classes implementing iterator patterns for container traversal, including support for locking mechanisms. It is a core component for iterating over container data structures within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: IIterator
classes.description: An interface for iterator operations, including navigation and validation methods.

classes.name: IteratorType
classes.description: A template class implementing IIterator for standard container iteration.

classes.name: IteratorMapType
classes.description: A template class implementing IIterator for map container iteration, providing access to keys and values.

classes.name: LockableIteratorType
classes.description: A thread-safe iterator that manages read locks on the container during iteration.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specified position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the iterator is currently at a valid position.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Returns the current index of the iterator.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements in the container.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Returns the key of the current element in a map container.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns a reference to the current element.
